scope_corrections: Some unobserved physical tokens belong to experienced causal kinds and can be inferred.
Mental productive powers remain as unknown as physical productive powers.
Independence from this observer is distinct from non-perceptual matter or independence from every mind.
Sympathy can occur without corresponding present feeling in another; it cannot by itself certify that feeling.
Testimony cannot bootstrap independently observed other consciousness without circularity.
